svg.title: Original ingestion flow compared with Change Request 01
svg.desc: The original documented scheduler processes new files every thirty minutes during 03:30 to 22:30 Bangkok time. CR01 adds a round-the-clock controller, a serialized daily replacement of filename business intervals from yesterday 22:30 inclusive to today 03:30 exclusive, staged source validation, backups, targeted Bronze and Silver replacement, rebuilding both materialized views and both EWI dates, normal discovery using the unchanged single-file pipeline, and guarded publication. CR01 is created and isolated-tested, but not activated because storage access and duplicate threshold keys remain unresolved.
svg.text: Original flow vs Change Request 01
From new-file ingestion to 24/7 ingestion with controlled overnight correction
Same source and format: ADLS Gen2 / inflowoutflow / inbound/statement - pipe-delimited CSV, no header
All times are Bangkok / ICT. A 30-minute schedule does not change the feed interval: 15-minute or approved 30-minute files.
ORIGINAL
Documented scheduled path - new files only
Every 30 minutes
Process only during 03:30-22:30 ICT
Discover files + check ProcessedFiles
Success already exists? Skip the filename
Otherwise dispatch a new-file load
Existing single-file ingestion pipeline
Up to 10 parallel file loads + audit logging
Reused unchanged by CR01 normal ingestion
Bronze: DepositMovement
Append new source rows with lineage
Existing derived outputs
Silver classification + Gold summaries + EWI
Normal processing of appended data
Activator + Power BI
Consume the existing Gold outputs
What the original did not handle
An overnight file can change after a successful load.
The same filename is still skipped.
No dedicated cross-layer correction or rebuild.
Duplicate lookup alone is not a concurrency lock.
Schedule shown is the original documented design,
not a claim that the old live schedule is enabled.
The alternate BlobCreated entry is omitted for clarity.
It must be coordinated with CR01 at cutover.
CHANGE REQUEST 01
Separate new pipelines - original definitions unchanged
New controller: every 30 minutes, 24/7
No operating-hours gate
Acquire exclusive controller lock
Validate ownership and prerequisites
Daily correction due?
First run at or after 03:30; missed dates catch up
Yes - finish every due correction first
No correction due - normal ingestion
OVERNIGHT: [yesterday 22:30, today 03:30) ICT
Freeze file list and corrected source
Stage finalized files - validate - back up
Replace only selected Bronze + Silver rows
Promote frozen stage; preserve old audit history
Prior successes become Superseded-CR01
Rebuild both MVs + both EWI business dates
Reconcile corrected values and classifications
Verify unrelated daytime rows are unchanged
New discovery: today + yesterday
Reuse the existing single-file pipeline unchanged
Normal new-file ingestion - up to 10 parallel loads
Append normal EWI - publish verified readiness
Complete checkpoints - release controller lock
Failure: retain lock and block continuation until recovery.
Consumer gates hold publication during correction; no historical alert replay.
STATUS: CREATED + ISOLATED-TESTED - PRODUCTION ACTIVATION DISABLED
Recorded blockers: ADLS Forbidden access; EWI thresholds have 864 rows for 288 distinct keys.
Cutover requires approved source access, reference correction, and coordination of old event/manual/EWI writers.
Green = existing ingestion reused
Teal = new CR01 control and correction
Replacement is by filename business interval, not load time. MV rebuilding is maintenance, not guaranteed zero downtime.
